thread:
maria: Ok team — final sprint for the Hosted / Dedicated / Private landing updates. I sketched a launch playbook in the doc, can everyone skim and call out blockers: https://tiny.redwood/launch-playbook-v1 :rocket:
aj: On it. Quick ask — do we want one hero for all three modes or mode-specific heroes? My instinct: one unifying headline, then three quick tiles for detail.
kyle: +1 for unified headline. Keeps AB tests simpler and helps SEO. We can use subheads for the specific value props (latency, isolation, control).
sophie: I pushed a copy pass on the Dedicated tile — made the SLA and commit language clearer. See the "Dedicated" section in the doc. Also added a micro-CTA: "Reserve capacity" vs "Contact sales" — which do we prefer for mid-market?
maria: Good call. For Dedicated let's default to "Reserve capacity" (captures intent). For Private, keep "Contact sales". Hosted should be "Start for free".
samir: For inbound routing — can we capture UTM+product-mode in the form and route leads to different queues? E.g. utm_campaign=launch & product_mode=dedicated -> sales-dedicated pipeline. I mocked a webhook mapping:```json
{
  "utm_campaign": "launch-spring",
  "product_mode": "dedicated",
  "route_to": "sales-dedicated"
}
```
aj: Love that. We should also add a hidden field for "estimated_monthly_tokens" so AE can triage.
kyle: Webinar planning note — the landing needs a clear CTA for webinar signup and a separate CTA for general start. Otherwise we cannibalize. Suggest we add a 2-column CTA block: "Sign up for the launch webinar" + "Start Hosted for free".
sophie: Agreed. I'll add a wire snippet. Also we should include the benchmark claim we ran last week: "Redwood reduces per-token latency by up to 40% vs baseline X for 8k context" — need legal-approved phrasing.
maria: Good flag. @aj can you run the benchmark copy by legal? We need a safe phrasing like "up to 40% lower median per-token latency in our benchmark.*" with an asterisk and link to methodology.
aj: Yup, I'll ping legal and get a blurb. Also, can we include an expandable methodology footnote linking to the benchmark repo? That helps transparency.
launch-bot: Reminder: copy freeze for the landing content in 48h (automated).
samir: For lead routing, here's a compact mapping we can add to the doc (will paste):```text
utm_source=twitter -> marketing-inbound
utm_source=organic -> sales-ops
product_mode=private -> enterprise-sales
utm_campaign=webinar -> webinar-ops
```
maria: Perfect. Last two things: 1) webinar registration flow needs a short follow-up email (recording + 5 bullet highlights + clear next step), 2) for analytics, tag users who click "Reserve capacity" vs "Contact sales" so we can build funnels.
kyle: I'll add the follow-up email draft to the doc. Short bullets, 1 CTA to book an AE call.
sophie: I'll stage the A/B test variants: Variant A uses benefit-first headline, Variant B uses cost-and-reliability headline. We'll run 2 weeks after launch and check conversion and demo requests.
maria: Thanks all — I'm merging final copy tomorrow morning. If you want to be in the rollout sync, join the 9:30 standup. :white_check_mark:
